description: This file defines the GreaterBinary class in Twig, which represents a binary expression node for the 'greater than' (>) operator within Twig's expression parser. It includes a compile method that generates PHP code for this operation, taking into account PHP version differences.

classes.name: GreaterBinary
classes.description: Represents a 'greater than' binary expression node for Twig's template engine, providing methods for compilation and operator representation.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code for the greater-than binary expression, considering PHP version compatibility.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Returns the raw operator symbol '>' for this binary expression.
